selected_evidence.summary: Live /srv/data was corrupted/deleted/augmented, diff showed divergence from the snapshot, rsync --delete restored from the snapshot, and sha256 + diff -rq confirmed the restored directory is byte-identical to both the original baseline and the snapshot subvolume

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step1: create backing btrfs image =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /mnt/srv-data-btrfs /srv/data
sudo -n truncate -s 2G /var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img
sudo -n mkfs.btrfs -f -L srvdata /var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img

echo "== step2: mount top-level subvolume =="
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -f)
sudo -n losetup "$LOOPDEV" /var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img
sudo -n mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 "$LOOPDEV" /mnt/srv-data-btrfs
echo "loopdev=$LOOPDEV"

echo "== step3: create data subvolume + snapshots dir =="
sudo -n btrfs subvolume create /mnt/srv-data-btrfs/data
sudo -n mkdir -p /mnt/srv-data-btrfs/snapshots

echo "== step4: bind mount /srv/data to the data subvolume via loop device =="
LOOPDEV2=$(sudo -n losetup -f)
sudo -n losetup "$LOOPDEV2" /var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img
sudo -n mount -t btrfs -o "subvol=data" "$LOOPDEV2" /srv/data
echo "loopdev2=$LOOPDEV2"

echo "== step5: persist in fstab (use LABEL + subvol, works across reboot via loop autoclear? use systemd mount instead) =="
# Use /etc/fstab with the image file path and loop option so it works after reboot without needing to remember loop device names
grep -q '/var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img' /etc/fstab || sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null <<'EOF'
/var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img /mnt/srv-data-btrfs btrfs loop,subvolid=5,nofail 0 0
/var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img /srv/data btrfs loop,subvol=data,nofail 0 0
EOF
cat /etc/fstab | grep srv-data-btrfs

echo "== verify mounts =="
mount | grep srv-data
df -hT /srv/data /mnt/srv-data-btrfs

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== cleanup stray loop2 =="
sudo -n losetup -d /dev/loop2 2>/dev/null || true

echo "== revert earlier fstab lines (replacing with systemd unit) =="
sudo -n sed -i '/srv-data-btrfs\.img/d' /etc/fstab
grep -c srv-data-btrfs /etc/fstab || true

echo "== write mount script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-btrfs-mount.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img
TOPMNT=/mnt/srv-data-btrfs
DATAMNT=/srv/data
mkdir -p "$TOPMNT" "$DATAMNT"
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f)
  losetup "$LOOPDEV" "$IMG"
fi
mountpoint -q "$TOPMNT" || mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 "$LOOPDEV" "$TOPMNT"
mountpoint -q "$DATAMNT" || mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/data "$LOOPDEV" "$DATAMNT"
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-btrfs-mount.sh

echo "== write umount script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-btrfs-umount.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
IMG=/var/lib/srv-data-btrfs.img
TOPMNT=/mnt/srv-data-btrfs
DATAMNT=/srv/data
umount "$DATAMNT" 2>/dev/null || true
umount "$TOPMNT" 2>/dev/null || true
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
[ -n "$LOOPDEV" ] && losetup -d "$LOOPDEV" || true
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-btrfs-umount.sh

echo "== systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-btrfs.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Mount srv-data btrfs loop image (top + data subvolume)
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service local-fs-pre.target
Before=local-fs.target
Conflicts=umount.target
Before=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-btrfs-mount.sh
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-btrfs-umount.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srv-data-btrfs.service

echo "== tear down manual mounts, then bring up via the service (cold-start validation) =="
sudo -n umount /srv/data
sudo -n umount /mnt/srv-data-btrfs
sudo -n losetup -d /dev/loop0

sudo -n systemctl start srv-data-btrfs.service
systemctl is-active srv-data-btrfs.service
mount | grep srv-data
df -hT /srv/data /mnt/srv-data-btrfs
